TYPE. body_text_size_px 21.0 is cap-top-to-baseline, measured on right-column lines at y 433-453 px and y 1095-1115 px (both read 21 px). Baseline pitch is a uniform 39 px (0.01667 of page height) everywhere on the page, right column and full measure alike. NCERT adds NO extra lead between paragraphs here - the only paragraph marker is a first-line indent of 0.0302 of page width (0.6016 -> 0.6324 in the right column, 0.2890 -> 0.3192 at full measure), which is why space_before between n=3/n=4/n=5/n=6 is only 0.0047-0.0077. I did not put that first-line indent in the `indent` field because the brief defines `indent` as the element's LEFT EDGE being inset from its column, and none of these blocks is block-indented; the value is recorded here instead. The caption's tint box starts at the left column edge and insets its text by 0.0085 as internal padding, and its second line hangs to 0.2056 to align under the '(a)' of line one - again internal, so no `indent` reported. size_pt 9.3 on the caption is DERIVED, not read: 18 px cap height at 200 dpi = 6.48 pt cap, divided by an assumed 0.70 cap/em. On the same derivation body type is about 10.8 pt. size_rel is the trusted number; I report size_pt nowhere else. space_before is measured as this element's top minus the bottom of the nearest element above it that OVERLAPS IT HORIZONTALLY, so n=3 measures against the running head rather than the figure.
